limitations: Curator-only: original sources include historically exposed responses; discovery workers must not read this source root
No evaluator vault is accessed and no test targets are exported
NIST record revision and README version differ and are bound separately
Reconstruction does not establish scientific admission, independence or redistribution approval

partition_provenance.allocation: Original Rabi blocks 06/09 are test; other whole blocks are sorted by canonical SHA256([compact-v2, case, opaque group]) and the first two are dev. Coordinates in one cell are not independent apparatus replications.

policy.coordinates: Original physical CSV rows and exact stored delta_c/(2*pi), Omega_p/(2*pi) in MHz; no interpolation or normalization
policy.domain: All finite stored ion amplitudes with abs(detuning_MHz) <= 60; retain zero/negative signals and explicit missingness
policy.excluded: Optical/EIT signals, fitted widths/amplitudes, RF calibration, noise, sensitivity and alternate spectra cannot be predictors
policy.group: Contiguous blocks of 30 sorted Rabi grid coordinates; all detuning samples stay with their block
policy.source_processing: The dense exported grid has not been verified as independent native acquisitions; relationship to original measured scans and interpolation remains an admission gate

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Measurement/identity specification independently reimplemented; no fitting, scientific rule, reference state or evaluator copied
